name: Maineiax Lacrosse Boys & Girls Summer Camps
description_short: Half-day (9:30am-12:00pm), 4-day lacrosse camps for boys and girls entering grades 2-8 in fall 2026, held outdoors on town fields in Scarborough, Brunswick, Cumberland, Kennebunk and Cape Elizabeth. Players are grouped by age and skill level, and you register through each town's Parks & Recreation department.
refund_policy_summary: All Maineiax payments are non-refundable. If a player is injured or ill before the program starts and you send a doctor's note before the start date, you get a house credit good for any Maineiax program until the end of that calendar year. Absences, mid-program cancellations and weather cancellations are not credited or refunded. Transfers to another program are honored if space allows and you ask three weeks ahead.
